hypothesis: NVIDIAのQ2末AR 63.059B USDについて、Q3 revenue guidance 108B USDの下でAR/revenueをQ1水準へ戻すための追加collectionは、FY2027残期間cash gap 7.105855B USDを上回る。

decision_rule.use_if: Q1 AR/revenue水準への正常化が7.105855B USD以上のAR releaseを生み、かつ後続reported cash flowで同等以上のcash conversionが確認される。
decision_rule.condition_if: Q1水準への正常化で数学的には7.105855B USD以上をreleaseできるが、Q3 actual revenueまたはreported collectionが未確認。
decision_rule.reject_if: Q1水準へ正常化してもAR releaseが7.105855B USD未満、またはQ2比率維持の単純代替より意思決定上有利でない。
decision_rule.unverified_if: Q1/Q2 ending AR、Q1/Q2 revenue、Q3 guidance、またはcanonical cash gapを一次情報/canonical artifactで確認できない。

decision_context.who: NVIDIAのnear-term commitment riskを評価するportfolio/valuation consumer
decision_context.before: 必要AR recoveryは7.105855B USDと判明していたが、売上規模に対してどの程度のAR正常化を意味するか未接続だった。
decision_context.after: Q3 revenue 108B USDならQ1 AR/revenueへの完全正常化は9.188020B USDをreleaseし、必要gapの129.309%を満たす。cash-gapだけを埋めるにはAR/revenue 51.808468%までの改善で足りる。
decision_context.verification: SECのQ1/Q2 point-in-time balancesとquarterly revenueを使い、Q3 guidanceに対するending AR、implied collection、cash coverageを再計算する。

primary_sources: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Form 10-Q, quarter ended 2026-04-26: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000052/nvda-20260426.htm
NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q, quarter ended 2026-07-26: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000075/nvda-20260726.htm

method.point_in_time: Use filings available by 2026-08-26 and canonical artifacts already merged before this run. Q3 actual and later cash-flow realization are not used.
method.main_measure: Ending AR/revenue intensity = quarter-end net accounts receivable / quarterly revenue. Apply the Q1 intensity to Q3 guidance revenue to derive a Q1-normalized Q3 ending AR.
method.implied_collection: Q3 implied cash collection from customers = Q2 ending AR + Q3 revenue - Q3 ending AR. The incremental cash versus holding ending AR flat equals the reduction in ending AR.
method.benchmark: No normalization: hold Q3 ending AR at 63.059B USD, so collection equals Q3 revenue and no incremental cash closes the 7.105855B USD gap.
method.alternative: Maintain Q2 AR/revenue intensity at Q3 guidance revenue; this grows ending AR and consumes cash. Separately solve the minimum ending AR that releases exactly 7.105855B USD.
method.leakage_and_costs: No look-ahead to Q3 actual. Transaction cost, slippage, tax, Sharpe, volatility, maximum drawdown and Expected Shortfall are NOT_APPLICABLE because this is point-in-time fundamental cash-conversion research, not a trading strategy.
method.dso_note: Ending-balance DSO uses 91 calendar days only as a diagnostic. It is not average-AR DSO and is not the primary decision measure.

maintain_q2_intensity_alternative.interpretation: Q3 revenue growth alone does not normalize cash conversion; maintaining Q2 intensity absorbs another 7.719437B USD in AR.

exact_cash_gap_threshold.interpretation: 完全なQ1水準復帰は不要。Q2の65.535590%から51.808468%まで改善すれば7.105855B USDをreleaseできる。

benchmark_and_alternative.no_normalization: Ending AR据え置きでは追加cashは0でcoverageは0.922762x。
benchmark_and_alternative.q2_intensity_maintenance: 売上が108B USDへ増えてもQ2 intensityを維持するとARは7.719437B USD増え、cash conversionはさらに悪化する。
benchmark_and_alternative.q1_intensity_restoration: Q1 intensityへ戻れば9.188020B USDをreleaseし、cash gapを2.082165B USD上回りcoverageは1.022632x。
benchmark_and_alternative.minimum_threshold: 完全正常化の77.338259%で足り、必要ending AR/revenueは51.808468%。

verdict.reason: Q1 AR/revenue水準への正常化は9.188020B USDをreleaseし、7.105855B USD gapを129.301%カバーするため、数学的なbridgeは成立する。しかしQ3 revenueはguidanceであり、Q3 reported collectionはまだ存在しない。さらにQ2 intensityを維持するだけでは7.719437B USDの追加AR buildになるため、売上成長だけをcash recoveryとみなせない。
verdict.capital_allocation_implication: FY2027 commitment riskの監視値を『7.106B USD回収』から『Q3 ending AR 55.953B USD以下、またはAR/revenue 51.808%以下』へ変換する。Q3 actualでこの閾値を満たすまでvaluation supportを確定しない。

implementation.artifact_type: AR intensity normalization threshold decision/evaluation artifact
implementation.delete_or_cleanup: 専用code/config/workflow/one-off scriptは作成しておらず、削除対象なし。

limitations: Ending AR/revenue is a point-in-time intensity measure and does not reveal invoice-level aging or customer payment schedules.
Implied collection assumes revenue and AR movements dominate the customer-cash bridge; acquisitions, FX, write-offs and gross-versus-net presentation can create differences.
Q3 revenue 108B USD is company guidance, not actual revenue.
The 7.105855B USD gap inherits Q3/Q4 revenue 108B USD each and treats the 92B USD commitment as an economic cash-coverage target rather than same-period contractual cash payment.
Q1 normalization is a sensitivity, not a forecast; reported Q3 cash flow is required for adoption.
next_high_value_hypothesis: Q3 actualが出るまで新しい同一入力のAR sensitivityは増やさず、次は92B USD commitmentのcash-out timingを支払条件・inventory purchase obligations・supplier prepaymentsの開示から分解できるかを検証する。分解不能ならQ3 actual filingまで再開しない。
